# Font Awesome Free 6.0.0 (solid icons only)

Copied unchanged from the npm package `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.0.0`, so both pages show their
icons without a network: `css/fontawesome.min.css`, `css/solid.min.css`, and the solid webfont in
`webfonts/`. EWOK uses only the `fas` (solid) style, so the regular and brands fonts are left out.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, copy the same files from a newer package and check that every
`fa-*` name EWOK uses still exists (`tests/test_offline_icons.py` does this).
